periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees downward from the posterior toward the anterior facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering toward the muzzle, extending below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shaped curvature on the posterior edge of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending from the base of the neck to approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between the two ear regions, approximately equal to the horizontal width of one ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex curvature at the apex of the ears.
